events.speaker: SABLE
events.text: That rope's not going to hold him, and grabbing at his head sure won't either. Give me room and don't chase anything -- we settle this one horse at a time.

events.speaker: SABLE
events.text: Every one of them caught, and not a leg pulled up lame doing it. That gelding'll trust a rope again by next week. Most people won't.

events.speaker: SABLE
events.text: An outfit that let me do it my way instead of yours. I'll take that deal. Try to keep up with the string.

events.speaker: SABLE
events.text: I judge most things by whether they spook a green horse. You don't. That's about the highest compliment I hand out.
